name: Yuu
source:
A boy blessed with the ability of "Healing" to cure monsters.

Due to lethargy and a phobia of monsters, he spent his ordinary days in a remote village. One day, he listened to the bottled girl Merc's wish of "I want to learn about myself", and left on a journey around the world. At first there were times when he was hopeless, but while traveling he meets various people and monsters, and as a "Healer", grows up little by little.
